title: PR 21 and 24 closing comments
text: Closing comments for PRs #21 and #24 (both already in the game), to post and close on your OK. #21 (CinnamonVII): "Thank you for this, and for rebasing it with the fixes from #12. It no longer applied to current code, so we ported it manually with you as co-author on the commit, and partly built lines now run their longest built stretch in the game. Closing this one since it's in. Thanks again!" #24 (caelum418): "Closing this now that the port is in the game (it shipped in 0.4.5, as the reply above says). Thanks again for the speedup and the write-up!"

title: Use more cores on or off
text: Your tab had "Use more cores" on when Shenyang stalled (5 workers at the start); our notes say you play with it off on purpose, as the median player. Which is it now? We time big-save waits your way.

title: Rename stations text
text: New text from T-4259 (renaming a line's stations together), all new: icon hover "Rename stations", then "Paste a list of names into a box to fill it and the ones below"; screen-reader labels "Rename stations" and "New name for {name}"; button "Rename" / "Rename 1 station" / "Rename 3 stations"; button "Cancel" (reused). OK?

title: Speedometer text
text: New text from T-4243 (the speed dial on a train's panel): the dial's hover "Top speed 160 km/h" (new). The unit under the number reuses the game's km/h or mph. OK?

title: OpenFreeMap through our own address
text: Roads and water (T-4275): since 11-24 23:11 UTC, EasyPrivacy (on by default in uBlock Origin and Brave; NordVPN behaves the same) blocks OpenFreeMap's planet tiles on every site. Master now falls back to an address the rule misses, ready for the hotfix. The lasting fix is serving OpenFreeMap through our own address (a Cloudflare Worker at data.anita.garden/ofm/ with caching; OpenFreeMap's terms checked first), a server change. Set it up? I'd say yes. Also: 11 of your website's maps use OpenFreeMap (korearail, cityhistory, londonriders, flights, languagedots, nycriders, japanrail, religiondots, noritetsu, ancestrydotsna, ancestrydots) and may be blank behind the same rule.

title: Rename key text
text: New text from T-4273: the help panel's Keys list gets "R  Rename the open station" (new). R because F2 already hides the interface. OK, or another key?
